author: National Geographic
description:
What happened when the United States withdrew from Afghanistan? Join National Geographic to go Inside the CIA to discover the incredible untold true story of a former CIA officer named Laura Thomas who used her exfiltration skills and network to coordinate a daring volunteer rescue mission behind enemy lines during the 2021 U.S. withdrawal. In this full episode of Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies, watch military history unfold through high-stakes tactical operations and true spy stories.
